ns2:section.sectionText: Discovery Course - First time Freshmen only. Topic: Sexuality and Literature: Examination of the historical contexts in which sexuality has been debated during the past three centuries, and to what extent sexuality is perceived differently in diverse cultures. Part one will look at the Western tradition, especially Germany and France. Part two will shift focus to the non-Western world, especially to the colonial history of Indonesia. Same as CWL 272 and GER 270 This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for a Literature and the Arts course. Instructor website: http://www.germanic.illinois.edu/people/niekerk
